```{r}
library("readr")
Aspirin <- read_delim("Aspirin.csv", 
    delim = ";", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Aspirin


aspirin <- read.csv("Aspirin.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)
aspirin
```

```{r}
summary(aspirin)
```



```{r}
table(aspirin$Group)
prop.table(table(aspirin$Group))
```

```{r}
table(aspirin$Heart)
prop.table(table(aspirin$Heart))
```
```{r}
tab <- table(aspirin$Group, aspirin$Heart)
tab
prop.table(tab, margin = 1)



fisher.test(tab)
chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)
```

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(tab)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Gruppe", y = "Anteil", fill = "Herzinfarkt") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
rate <- prop.table(tab, 1)[, "Yes"]

# ggplot(rate, aes(x = ))

barplot(rate, ylim = c(0, max(rate)*1.2),
        main = "Herzinfarktrate nach Gruppe",
        ylab = "Rate",
        col = c("steelblue", "firebrick"))
```

```{r}
library(epiR)
res <- epi.2by2(tab, method = "cohort.count")

forestplot::forestplot(
  labeltext = c("Risk Ratio", "Odds Ratio"),
  mean = c(res$massoc$RR.crude[1], res$massoc$OR.crude[1]),
  lower = c(res$massoc$RR.crude[2], res$massoc$OR.crude[2]),
  upper = c(res$massoc$RR.crude[3], res$massoc$OR.crude[3])
)

epi.2by2(tab,
         method = "cohort.count",
         conf.level = 0.95)

```

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(tab)

ggplot(df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "steelblue", high = "red") +
  labs(x = "Gruppe", y = "Herzinfarkt") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
a <- tab[1, 2]  # Exponiert & Ereignis
b <- tab[1, 1]  # Exponiert & kein Ereignis
c <- tab[2, 2]  # Kontrolle & Ereignis
d <- tab[2, 1]  # Kontrolle & kein Ereignis

# Risiken
p1 <- a / (a + b)
p0 <- c / (c + d)

# Risk Ratio
RR <- p1 / p0

# Odds
odds1 <- a / b
odds0 <- c / d

# Odds Ratio
OR <- (a * d) / (b * c)
# odds1/odds0


RR
OR
```


```{r}
epi.2by2(tab,
         method = "cohort.count",
         conf.level = 0.95)
```

```{r}
fisher.test(tab[, c("Yes", "No")], alternative = "less")
```
